probe_detail.name: Argues the step a competent reader would stop at
Use of AoPS forum markup furniture
Delivers the object the problem asked for

final.name: Validation-seeking and uncertain posture
final.audit_justification: Scores rhetorical posture (hedging vs. confident) rather than which mathematical technique was used, though genuinely uncertain solvers may also be more likely to have missed the canonical method.

final.name: Algebraic step transparency
final.audit_justification: Measures how much intermediate algebra is spelled out, a presentation-completeness trait that can co-occur with any approach, though careful step-showing may correlate with actually having found a correct/canonical line of reasoning.

final.name: Explicit claim-proof structuring
final.audit_justification: Rewards the presence of 'Claim:'/'Lemma:' organizational labels, a template/formatting habit rather than evidence of which technique was used, though structured writers may also be more likely to mirror a lemma-based canonical proof.

final.name: Strategic use of symmetry
final.audit_justification: Directly tests whether a specific technique (symmetry/invariance) is used and load-bearing, which is squarely evidence of whether the approach matches a canonical symmetry-based solution.

final.name: Legacy autocorrupted LaTeX and era-marked forum markup
final.audit_justification: Pure typographic/era markup fingerprint of old forum software with no plausible bearing on which solution technique was used.
final.upstream_parent: the calendar era in which the post was written (and later software migrations that rewrote old posts)

final.name: Absence of unconventional-approach markers
final.audit_justification: Scores the poster's own rhetorical self-labeling of their approach as unconventional, a word-choice/register marker, though such self-flagging plausibly does track genuine deviation from the standard approach.

final.name: Contest-conditions self-report and score talk
final.audit_justification: Purely a self-report of the production circumstance (contest conditions, timing, scores) with no bearing on which mathematical approach was taken.
final.upstream_parent: timing of production/submission relative to the competition (a same-week contestant post versus a later archival write-up)

final.name: Colloquial and emotional register
final.audit_justification: Measures colloquial/emotional register and slang, an orthographic-habit marker unrelated to the mathematical technique used.
final.upstream_parent: poster's practice in the format / audience expectation

final.name: Global closure of local alternatives
final.audit_justification: Tests whether a specific proof-completion maneuver (combining pointwise cases into one globally consistent, mixed-assignment-excluding form) was executed, which is evidence of the specific technique used.

final.name: Answer-choice anchoring
final.audit_justification: Scores an assessment-format trace (foregrounding of option letters/answer-checking language) rather than the underlying technique, though it may co-occur with genuinely working the problem via elimination rather than direct computation.

final.name: Single external theorem does all the work
final.audit_justification: Directly distinguishes a citation-driven approach from one built on problem-specific reasoning, which is exactly whether the solving strategy matches a from-scratch canonical argument.

final.name: Exploits the multiple-choice option list
final.audit_justification: Tests whether the solving strategy relies on process-of-elimination via the option list versus direct derivation, a direct marker of which approach was taken.

final.name: Completeness of candidate classification
final.audit_justification: Tests whether a classify-and-verify method was carried out completely, evidencing whether the specific solving technique matches a canonical exhaustive classification.

final.name: Explicit self-assessment labels
final.audit_justification: Counts self-descriptive labels like 'cheap' or 'scuffed', a rhetorical self-report rather than mathematical substance, though such labeling plausibly correlates with the approach genuinely being nonstandard.

final.name: Inter-post referencing and sequence markers
final.audit_justification: Measures references to other posts/posters and thread position, a social/production-circumstance marker with no bearing on the mathematical approach.

final.name: Isolable pivotal-fact statement
final.audit_justification: Tests whether the post isolates the same kind of crux identity/lemma that a canonical write-up would center on, which is direct evidence about the substance of the approach used.

final.name: Names and separately addresses a trap or edge case
final.audit_justification: Rewards explicit, separately-labeled naming of a trap over implicit handling within general casework (scoring implicit correct handling the same as omission), so it tracks presentation style more than whether the edge case was actually addressed; explicit callouts may still correlate with genuinely careful, canonical-matching handling.

final.name: Collaboration attribution
final.audit_justification: Measures explicit acknowledgment of collaborators or helpers, a social-attribution marker unrelated to which technique was used, though collaboratively vetted solutions could plausibly be nudged toward the standard approach.

final.name: Exact modular periodicity
final.audit_justification: Tests execution of a specific technique (proving and exhaustively applying a modular period), directly evidencing whether that particular method was used.

final.name: Method sophistication proportionality to problem
final.audit_justification: Directly tests whether the sophistication/level of the tools used matches what the problem calls for, which is evidence about whether the technique matches a canonical elementary-appropriate method.

final.name: Density of display mathematics and align environments
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a typesetting measure (display vs. inline math) with the criterion itself disclaiming any judgment of the mathematics, so it is pure formatting.
final.upstream_parent: the poster's practice and fluency with the forum's typesetting conventions

final.name: Post questions or disowns the argument it posts
final.audit_justification: Scores the post's rhetorical stance toward its own argument (asserted vs. questioned/disowned) rather than which technique is used, though a disowned argument may plausibly be more likely to diverge from the canonical approach.

final.name: Objective-preserving optimization
final.audit_justification: Tests execution of a specific optimization technique (rigorous objective-preserving reduction), direct evidence of the solving method used.

final.name: Markup scaffolding
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores visual/organizational scaffolding (hides, headings, bullets, boxes) and disclaims judging whether it helps, a pure formatting marker.

final.name: Generalizes beyond the minimum needed
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the post adds elaboration beyond the minimum required answer, an elaboration/verbosity-style trait, though solvers who generalize may also be more likely to have engaged with the problem the way a canonical write-up does.
